# Inter variable font

Unmodified Latin weight-variable WOFF2 from `@fontsource-variable/inter` 5.3.0, also used by the local Genkoy reference project. Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors. Licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL-Inter.txt`. Font source: https://github.com/rsms/inter ; packaging: https://fontsource.org/fonts/inter . Only this font asset is covered by OFL; it does not change the repository's proprietary source-code license. Chinese glyphs use the operating system's existing fallback fonts. No remote font service or additional font weight download is required.

Unmodified Latin variable JetBrains Mono from `@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono` 5.3.0; SIL OFL 1.1, see `OFL-JetBrains-Mono.txt`. Source: https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono . It is used only where code is displayed, without preloading it in the teacher workspace.
